SPRINT 1 — InkOS Analytics Page Foundation. Project: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

Approved plan: /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/anaystics-page-lets-deep-fizzy-turtle.md (read first for full context).

## Goal
Wire global date-range picker + compare-to-prior toggle + page rename + shared CSV util through the entire /reports surface. Every later sprint depends on this foundation.

## Constraints
- Stack A: Next.js 16 + Supabase + Tailwind 4 + TypeScript strict, NO `any`
- CLAUDE.md at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/CLAUDE.md — read sections 4 (Brand), 5 (UI), 7 (Architecture), 8 (Forbidden), 9 (Antipatterns)
- Brand: ONLY Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust. No 5th color. Tabular-nums on every number. Custom shadow tokens only (shadow-soft, shadow-card, shadow-soft-md, shadow-lift) — NEVER shadow-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl
- All gated UI surfaces stay wrapped — `analytics` feature key (Studio+ tier per nav-config.ts:248)
- No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `console.log` (use lib/logger.ts)
- Zod for input validation. cookies() async in Next 16.

## Existing infra to reuse (DO NOT rebuild)
- `components/ui/date-range-picker.tsx` — production-ready DateRangePicker, 7 presets, exports `DateRange` type
- `components/shared/KpiCard.tsx` — already supports `delta`, `trend`, `invertTrend`, `subtextLabel`, `sparkline`
- `components/reports/RechartsAreaChart.tsx` + `RechartsBarChart.tsx`
- `components/reports/ReportsTabNav.tsx` — current tab nav (keep)
- `components/shared/PageHeader.tsx` — supports `breadcrumb` prop
- `lib/utils.ts` — has `formatCurrency`, `formatDate`, `cn`. Add `formatPercent`.
- `papaparse@5.5.3` installed
- `@tanstack/react-query` for data fetching
- `lib/rate-limit.ts` — `authedRatelimit`
- `lib/supabase/server.ts` — `getAuthenticatedUser`, `createClient`

## Tasks (execute in order)

### 1. Layout rename — app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx
- Change `metadata.title` `"Reports — InkOS"` → `"Analytics — InkOS"`
- Change `<PageHeader title="Reports" ...>` → `<PageHeader title="Analytics" description="Studio performance, by the numbers." />`
- Mount `<AnalyticsToolbar />` between PageHeader and PageViews

### 2. Build lib/analytics/range.ts (NEW)
Typed helpers, no `any`:
```ts
import { z } from 'zod'

export const RangeSchema = z.object({
  from: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
  to: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
  compare: z.enum(['0', '1']).optional().default('0'),
})

export type AnalyticsRange = { from: string; to: string }
export type ParsedRange = { current: AnalyticsRange; prior?: AnalyticsRange; compare: boolean }

export function defaultLast30(): AnalyticsRange
export function parseRange(searchParams: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | undefined>): ParsedRange
export function priorRange(r: AnalyticsRange): AnalyticsRange
export function rangeDays(r: AnalyticsRange): number
export function pickGroupBy(days: number): 'day' | 'week' | 'month'
```

### 3. Build lib/csv-export.ts (NEW)
papaparse wrapper:
```ts
export interface CsvExportOptions<T extends Record<string, unknown>> {
  filename: string
  rows: T[]
  headers?: Partial<Record<keyof T, string>>
}
export function exportRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(opts: CsvExportOptions<T>): void
```
Browser-only. Trigger via Blob + anchor click.

### 4. Add formatPercent to lib/utils.ts
JSDoc: input is percent number (12.5 means 12.5%). Locale en-US, tabular.

### 5. Build hooks/use-export-csv.ts + components/reports/AnalyticsExportProvider.tsx (NEW)
Registry pattern via React Context. Each tab calls `useExportCsv({ filename, getRows, headers })` to register. Toolbar reads pathname → looks up registered serializer → calls `exportRows`.

Provider mounted in layout (client wrapper). Map keyed by pathname. Auto-register on mount, deregister on unmount.

### 6. Build components/reports/AnalyticsToolbar.tsx (NEW)
Client component. Right-aligned row:
- DateRangePicker (default Last 30d) → router.replace `?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD`
- Compare toggle (shadcn `Switch` + label "Compare to prior period") → toggles `?compare=1`
- Export CSV button (Button outline sm + Download icon) → calls registered serializer

Behavior:
- URL params survive tab switches (router.replace, not push)
- Mobile: stack vertically below 640px
- Sticky on desktop scroll
- Tabular-nums on date label
- Brand: Bone bg, Stone text, Onyx CTAs, Rust only on active

### 7. Update every API route — accept range + compare
Files: `app/api/reports/{revenue,artists,clients,bookings,inventory,ai}/route.ts`

- Extend Zod with `from/to/compare`
- When compare='1', run current+prior queries in parallel via `Promise.all`
- Return `{ current: {...existing}, prior?: {...same shape} }`
- Default to last 30d if no from/to
- Filter by relevant date col: bookings → scheduled_at; revenue → payments.created_at; clients → clients.created_at; ai → created_at

### 8. Update every client — read URL params, key React Query
Files: `components/reports/{Revenue,Artists,Clients,Bookings,Inventory,AiUsage}ReportClient.tsx`

- `useSearchParams()` for from/to/compare
- Pass to fetch URL
- React Query key: `['reports', tab, from, to, compare]`
- Type response `{ current: T; prior?: T }`
- Render `current` block as before — Sprints 2/3 redesign these

### 9. Set explicit breadcrumb each tab page.tsx (or no-op if not rendered)
Verify current PageHeader behavior. If layout already renders title only and tabs are visible underneath, no breadcrumb to fix. Report findings.

### 10. Drop inline Export CSV from RevenueReportClient
Remove inline button + handler. Register via `useExportCsv` so global toolbar handles it.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Layout title "Analytics", metadata "Analytics — InkOS"
- [ ] DateRangePicker visible top-right every tab; default Last 30d; URL writes ?from, ?to
- [ ] Compare toggle adds ?compare=1; APIs return {current, prior} block
- [ ] Export CSV on every tab; downloads `analytics-{tab}-{from}-{to}.csv`
- [ ] React Query keys include from/to/compare
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build` all clean
- [ ] Mobile 375px: no horizontal overflow
- [ ] FeatureGate analytics still wraps every tab

## Validation gates (mandatory)
After all edits run:
```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm build
```
Fix every error before reporting done. If build fails, debug and re-run until green.

## Report format
Token-efficient. Caveman-style OK:
1. Files created (paths)
2. Files modified (paths)
3. Decisions made (toolbar position, param names, etc)
4. Validation gate results (pass/fail with output)
5. Follow-ups for Sprint 2
